label: Shape Intelligence — Evaluation and Promotion
goal: Build interpretative quality evaluation and deterministic canonical-promotion governance.
purpose: Measure candidate quality, collect review evidence, and apply authorized promotion with durable auditability.
success_condition: Evaluation is evidence-backed and promotion requires an explicit authorized owner, approved request, immutable receipt, and rollback path.
objectives: Define golden and adversarial evaluation corpus.
Define evaluation and review evidence records.
Define authorized promotion request and apply contracts.
